acceptance: A fresh validate-submission run (run id recorded) on a PR adding one valid bundle is green after the fix, and was red before it with the cause recorded
A unit test covers validator_parity with a bundle-plus-corpus diff in the form validate-submission produces
A PR adding a bundle under a disallowed path is still refused (test or recorded run)
description:
## Problem
.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml builds CORPUS_CHANGED_PATHS_FILE from both results-data/bundles/** and results-data/corpus/** (step "Collect corpus changed paths") and passes it to scripts/publication/validator_parity.py --corpus-changed-paths in "Validate bundles". validator_parity's corpus-path check returns 1 with "::error::Corpus changed path not under results-data/corpus/" for any other path. Reproduced 2026-11-17 against published-results HEAD (8aaa9921f7, 10 changed paths): the bundles-plus-corpus list exits 1, the corpus-only list exits 0 with "Parity OK". The last eight validate-submission runs all failed (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-17, including run 39072490523); their logs have expired, so the cause of those failures is unconfirmed. If the mismatch is the cause, every community submission that changes a bundle fails validation, and the publication path for outside contributors is broken.

## Decision gate
Confirm with a fresh run: open a throwaway same-repo PR to published-results that adds one valid fixture bundle (close it unmerged), or replay the workflow steps locally against a known-good bundle diff.
- If it fails on this check: decide which side is wrong. If validator_parity is meant to see only corpus-subtree paths, pass it a corpus-only list; if it is meant to accept bundles, widen its check. Pick the one that matches the parity script's tests and its docstring contract.
- If it fails for another reason, record that reason and fix that instead.

## Guardrails
- Do not weaken the allowlist check in validate_submission.py --corpus-changed-paths; it must still reject disallowed paths.
- No merge of the throwaway PR; no change to published-results content.
- The results mirror workflow (sync-results-data-to-published.yml) already passes a corpus-only list to validator_parity; keep the two consistent.
